description: This file contains power management and low power state handling code for Intel ADSP on Zephyr OS, including context save/restore, power down/up procedures, and interrupt management.

methods.name: power_init
methods.description: Initializes power gating settings based on configuration.

methods.name: power_down
methods.description: Performs power down sequence, including cache locking and memory shutdown.

methods.name: platform_context_restore
methods.description: Restores platform-specific context after system resume.

methods.name: boot_entry_d3_restore
methods.description: Entry point for D3 restore boot process.

methods.name: soc_mp_on_d3_exit
methods.description: Re-enables IDC interrupt for all cores after exiting D3 state.

methods.name: power_gate_entry
methods.description: Handles entering power gating for a specific core.

methods.name: power_gate_exit
methods.description: Handles exiting power gating and restoring core context.

methods.name: pm_state_imr_restore
methods.description: Restores IMR (Internal Memory Region) state after low power mode.

methods.name: pm_state_set
methods.description: Sets the power management state for the system or core.

methods.name: pm_state_exit_post_ops
methods.description: Performs post-exit operations after changing power states.
